description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Doomed Traveler, adding {C}{C}.
When Doomed Traveler dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Doomed Traveler trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
